title: Used a couple months and now it randomly switches speeds on it's own and stops oscillating!
text:
Used a couple months and now it randomly switches speeds on it's own and stops oscillating!. I got this to put on an end table in my bedroom to circulate air better and lately I've noticed when I wake up, it'll have switched from high to low. I thought it odd and thought maybe it was something I did but just now it was set on 4 and switched down to 2 and turned oscillation off. I'm the only one in the house, no one's here to change anything. It doesn't have a traditional remote so I doubt it's getting interference from anything and when it's done this, no one's pushing any buttons on anything. Lasko used to mean quality but lately their stuff has been garbage, not sure if they sold out to another company or what but they need to get their act together- this is insane!

It WAS a decent fan when it wasn't doing what it wanted to do. Now if I push the night mode button it will randomly flip it to high and dim the screen where previously it just dimmed the screen. This things insane!
